cards.title: Expansion continues under cost pressure
cards.body: Jobs and selective investment persist despite expensive finance. Support: strong realized sales, low layoffs and improving crude availability. Confirm: stable employment, funded schedules and collected cash. Invalidate: broad cancellations or funding failures; durable relief instead favors Bull.

cards.title: Cost relief broadens into durable improvement
cards.body: Delivered energy and funding costs ease while real demand strengthens. Support: strong investment demand and scope for delivered-cost relief as crude availability improves. Confirm: relief across multiple sectors and repeated deliveries. Invalidate: persistent cost pressure or spreading deferrals.

cards.title: Operating pressure spreads into retrenchment
cards.body: Cost and financing constraints cut orders, output and employment more broadly. Support: persistent price pressure, the verified 5.10% ten-year yield, weak housing and the cloud-capacity delay. Confirm: actual funding failures, cancellations and weaker labor demand. Invalidate: reliable delivery, sound financing and stronger real demand.
